колёсная база стоит сама, и модель задаё: the wheeled base stands on its own, and the model sets its velocity
куда ставить стопы, решает нижний уровен: where to place the feet is decided by the lower level

Оператор толкает базу сам, политика выда: The operator pushes the base along, and the policy outputs 14 target arm angles and the base's linear and angular velocity 50 times a second. A 14 kg battery sits at the bottom and serves as a counterweight, so the robot doesn't tip over.
педали: скорость, поворот, высота; руки: pedals: velocity, turning, height; arms by exoskeleton
Педали задают скорость вперёд и назад, п: The pedals set the forward and backward velocity, the turning and the torso height, and walking on these commands is handled by a policy trained with reinforcement learning. The arm angles come straight from the exoskeleton. An autonomous policy trained on 50 recordings outputs the same commands: the arm angles and the height.
скорость базы, наклон и высота торса: base velocity, torso tilt and height
Верхняя политика выдаёт углы рук и коман: The upper policy outputs the arm angles and a command for the lower one: the velocity, the torso orientation and the height. The lower one keeps balance and decides where to place the feet itself. The autonomous upper policy (ACT) was trained on 50 recordings per task.
голова, запястья, высота поясницы, коман: head, wrists, waist height, navigation command
Через три точки GR00T N1.5 выдаёт позы г: Through three points, GR00T N1.5 outputs the poses of the head and wrists, the height and a navigation command, and the leg motion is built by a kinematic planner. On the “apple onto a plate” task, from 300 trajectories, 90% success.
целевые углы 19 суставов тела, скорости: target angles of 19 body joints, torso velocities and tilt
HIT выдаёт целевые позы для трекера HST:: HIT outputs target poses for the HST tracker: the angles of all the body's joints, including the legs, and the torso's velocities and tilt. Balance is kept by HST, trained with reinforcement learning on 40 hours of human motion.
скорость и высота корпуса плюс углы всех: torso velocity and height plus the angles of all joints
Команда трекера включает углы всех суста: The tracker's command includes the angles of all the joints, including the legs, not just the torso velocity. The authors write that this is exactly what makes tasks with the legs possible: the robot pushes a box to a target with its foot in 6 attempts out of 7.
позы кистей, торса и обеих стоп: poses of the hands, torso and both feet
Модель на 450 млн параметров 30 раз в се: A 450-million-parameter model outputs the poses of the hands, torso and feet 30 times a second through the same interface as teleoperation, which is built on Boston Dynamics' MPC.
S1 выдаёт цели всех суставов, S0 их испо: S1 outputs targets for all joints, S0 executes them
S1 200 раз в секунду выдаёт цели суставо: S1 outputs joint targets for the whole body 200 times a second, and S0 executes them 1,000 times a second and keeps balance and contacts. This is how the robot closes a drawer with its hip when its hands are full. The levels of Helix 02 are covered in lesson 3.7.
вектор, выученный по записям движений: a vector learned from motion recordings
Модель зрения и языка 10 раз в секунду в: The vision-language model outputs a latent vector 10 times a second, and the whole-body controller turns it into target angles 50 times a second. Explicit interfaces, according to the authors, produce jittery motions because of infeasible commands.
64 числа токена движения и 14 углов кист: 64 numbers of a motion token and 14 hand angles
Через всё тело GR00T N1.5 выдаёт токен д: Through the whole body, GR00T N1.5 outputs a motion token: a learned code that the tracker can execute. With tokens, the model succeeded in 68% of attempts on three tasks on average, and with explicit whole-body poses in 27%.
Чем больше тела модель верхнего уровня з: The more of the body the upper-level model specifies itself, the more it can do: the TWIST2 robot pushes a box with its foot, and SONIC opens a trash can with its pedal. But the more precise the model has to be, because its errors go straight into the legs. The wheeled base of Mobile ALOHA doesn't need this choice: it stands on its own.

Модель VLA выдаёт пачку действий на доли: A VLA model outputs a chunk of actions a fraction of a second ahead. Why is it still not given the legs directly?
Пачка задаёт ноги хуже, чем углы суставо: A chunk specifies the legs worse than joint angles one at a time
Пачку строят по кадру, которому уже доли: The chunk is built from a frame that is already a fraction of a second old, and a torso on legs is unstable: the deviation from the plan grows faster than a new chunk arrives
Модели VLA не умеют выдавать углы сустав: VLA models can't output leg joint angles
В лаборатории 1 модель в уме считала шаг: In Lab 1, the model computed the steps in its head just as the whole-body controller did, but at 5 Hz the Ada with its plan spilled the tea after the first push and sometimes fell. A torso on legs behaves like an inverted pendulum: the deviation grows by a factor of e every 0.26 s.
Что делает контроллер всего тела в иерар: What does the whole-body controller do in a hierarchy like HumanPlus or TWIST2?
Решает, куда идти и что взять: It decides where to go and what to pick up
Получает целевую позу или скорость корпу: It receives a target pose or a torso velocity and, many times a second, outputs target joint angles so that the robot doesn't fall
Распознаёт предметы на картинке с камер: It recognizes objects in the camera image
HST в HumanPlus и трекер в TWIST2 обучен: HST in HumanPlus and the tracker in TWIST2 are trained with reinforcement learning in simulation on recordings of human motion, like the trackers of lesson 6.3. The upper-level model (HIT or Diffusion Policy) is in charge of the task and sends them commands 25 and 20 times a second.
Mobile ALOHA просто добавляет две скорос: Mobile ALOHA simply adds two base velocities to the policy's action. Why can't a humanoid do the same?
Колёсная база устойчива сама: если коман: A wheeled base is stable on its own: if the command is late, the robot goes the wrong way, but it doesn't fall
У Mobile ALOHA батарея массой 14 кг вниз: In Mobile ALOHA, a 14 kg battery at the bottom serves as a counterweight, and a late velocity command poses no danger. For a humanoid, a late command for the legs is a step in the wrong place, and without the right step the torso falls.
Телеоперация всем телом записывает коман: Whole-body teleoperation records the commands that the lower level received. Why is that convenient for an autonomous policy?
Записи потом легко проверить глазами: The recordings are easy to check by eye afterward
Политика учится выдавать те же команды т: The policy learns to output the same commands to the same whole-body controller, and the recordings immediately become its data
Записи можно проигрывать на роботе без п: The recordings can be replayed on the robot without a policy
В TWIST2 при сборе данных команды дают о: In TWIST2, during data collection the commands come from the operator and retargeting, and during operation from Diffusion Policy, with one and the same tracker beneath them. In HOMIE, the autonomous policy takes over from the operator and outputs the commands for the legs and the arm angles; in Atlas, the policy uses the same interface as teleoperation.
Политика по шагам из лаборатории 2 точно: The step policy from Lab 2 reproduces the recordings accurately, yet often falls or overshoots the shelf. Why?
Сеть слишком маленькая для такой задачи: The network is too small for such a task
В записях нет отклонений и того, как их: The recordings contain no deviations and no corrections of them: a small error takes Ada where the policy has seen nothing, and the error grows
Записей слишком много, и сеть их путает: There are too many recordings, and the network mixes them up
С ростом числа записей она не становилас: It got no better as the number of recordings grew, but after recordings with pushes it almost always coped, because corrections appeared in the data. This is the error accumulation from lesson 1.1, and it's cured by the same thing as DAgger in lesson 1.2: data on how to get out of deviations.
Чем хорош интерфейс «скорость корпуса и: What's good about the “torso velocity and hand positions” interface, and how is it limited?
Он задаёт всё тело точнее любого другого: It specifies the whole body more precisely than any other
Его легко выучить, и ошибки модели верхн: It's easy to learn, and the upper-level model's errors don't bring the robot down, but the feet are chosen by the lower level, so you can't step on a pedal this way
Так устроены HOMIE, AMO и три точки SONI: This is how HOMIE, AMO and SONIC's three points work. TWIST2 added the leg joint angles to the command and got tasks where a box is pushed with the foot, and SONIC with whole-body tokens opened a trash can with its pedal.
В SONIC модель VLA справлялась лучше, ко: In SONIC, the VLA model did better when it output motion tokens rather than whole-body poses. Why?
Токены точнее описывают позу, чем углы с: Tokens describe the pose more precisely than joint angles
Компактное пространство токенов легче вы: A compact token space is easier to learn from demonstrations, and small errors in whole-body poses turn into large tracking errors
Токены быстрее передаются по сети: Tokens are transmitted faster over the network
Так объясняют разницу авторы SONIC: на з: That's how the SONIC authors explain the difference: on the “can into the trash can with a pedal” task, the model with tokens succeeded in 60% of attempts, and with poses never. Explicit poses produced jerky motions and held direction poorly.
В Helix 02 три уровня. Почему самый нижн: Helix 02 has three levels. Why does the lowest one, S0, run most often?
Он самый большой из трёх: It's the largest of the three
Он держит равновесие и контакты, где оши: It keeps balance and contacts, where the error grows in fractions of a second, and it's small and fast itself
Так он видит больше кадров с камер: That way it sees more camera frames
S0 — сеть на 10 млн параметров, обученна: S0 is a 10-million-parameter network trained in simulation. It executes the joint targets that S1 outputs 200 times a second, while S2 decides what to do. The lower the level, the more often it runs and the smaller it is (lesson 3.7).
